Master
An educational degree
An educational degree is obtained at the second level of higher education and is awarded to a higher education learner by a higher education institution as a result of the successful relevant academic curriculum performance. Master Degree is acquired for educational-professional or educational-scientific program. The volume of the educational and professional program of training for the master's degree is 90 ECTS credits, the volume of the educational-scientific program is 120 ECTS credits. A person has the right to acquire a Master degree in the presence of a Bachelor degree.
